name: granola-sync
description: Pull fresh meetings from Granola (summaries, transcripts, participants) into an Obsidian vault over the official API. Incremental and idempotent by note id and updated_at, so re-runs make no duplicates. Triggers: "/granola-sync", "pull granola", "refresh meetings".
